name: prod-guard
description: Shows a red band while a session touches production and asks you before any command that may change it, even in auto mode

hosts.title: Production hosts
hosts.description: Comma-separated IPs, domains and SSH aliases

patterns.title: Other production commands
patterns.description: Space-separated regular expressions, for scripts that reach production by themselves, such as deploy\.sh

bandMinutes.title: Band duration (minutes)
bandMinutes.description: How long the band stays after the last command that touched production
